title: How does ABA therapy address sensory problems in children with Autism at Pinnacle Blooms?
metaTitle: ABA for Sensory Issues in Autism at Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Discover how Pinnacle Blooms Network uses combined techniques of ABA and Occupational therapy to address sensory issues in children with Autism.
html: In addressing sensory challenges in children with Autism at Pinnacle Blooms Network, we extensively use a combined approach. Modeling an interaction between Occupational Therapy primarily dealing with sensory integration issues as well as ABA therapy, we help children get conditioned to respond appropriately to sensory stimuli. Together, we work on fostering self-soothing techniques, develop coping strategies, and work on reducing any sensitivity to perceived problematic stimuli, all in a more engaging and child-friendly manner.
